title: pp.eqfilter-st~
description: `pp.eqfilter-st~` is the stereo version of `pp.eqfilter~`, filtering left and right input signals with selectable lowpass, highpass, resonant, bandpass, notch, peaking, allpass, lowshelf, or highshelf responses. Its frequency, Q, and gain can be controlled by messages, and the filter type can be supplied as a creation argument, as in `pp.eqfilter-st~ lowpass`.
